project.description: A focused workspace for small general contractors to chase missing certificates of insurance on live jobs.

cycle-6621082f677d4a759d24652f48a47272.title: Hand off first paid pilot kit
cycle-6621082f677d4a759d24652f48a47272.summary: Created the Cycle 5 first-pilot kit and four role reviews covering qualification, execution, reconciliation, evidence integrity, and stop rules. No customer, outreach, payment, receipt, or outcome is claimed; the product MVP and pre-existing registry change remain untouched.

cycle-8385f74fd9c74ab9b471b01bdb722dc6.title: Prepare the first paid pilot
cycle-8385f74fd9c74ab9b471b01bdb722dc6.summary: Completed the local pilot-readiness packet across operations, sales, product, and QA. The MVP is conditionally ready for one controlled pilot with an independent evidence log; no outreach, customer, payment, or outcome evidence exists yet.

cycle-25744e9d2c81491baf8e7ee9834faa0f.title: Hand off the COI chase desk MVP
cycle-25744e9d2c81491baf8e7ee9834faa0f.summary: The independent COI Chase Desk repository now contains a responsive paid-pilot workflow for one live job: request tracking, status filters, chase notes, evidence feedback, and CSV reporting. Delivery.md is registered, the preview root returned 200, and the program-owned Node check recorded 3 passes with 0 failures.

cycle-d9225e029ef04699bf27ee0e75ae9f2b.title: Complete COI chase desk decision
cycle-d9225e029ef04699bf27ee0e75ae9f2b.summary: Cycle 2 is complete: the team review produced a pre-mortem, market validation, unit-economics model, and a conditional GO. The next cycle will create the independent MVP repository and test the paid-pilot workflow against explicit customer, margin, and delivery gates.

cycle-44db5a97a9fe42c3be453347ad49d27c.title: Rank Day 0 product opportunities
cycle-44db5a97a9fe42c3be453347ad49d27c.summary: Completed the five-role fallback brainstorm, documented all proposals, ranked the top three, preserved governance sections, and set the next action to validate the certificate-of-insurance tracker before any build.
